subject: Candidate full-loop: slot bundling, panel swap protocol, debrief rotation
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Walker <alex.walker.outlook@gmail.com>, Oliver Reyes <oliver.reyes@recruitco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 09:06:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Interview availability / multi-slot orchestration

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for interviewing with Redwood. We want to lock a single-day full loop that bundles two shorter tracks (system design + product & culture) with a mid-day buffer for a technical pairing exercise. Target day: Tuesday, May 27.

High-level plan I propose:
- 09:30–10:15: System design panel (Karthik + guest)
- 10:30–11:00: Short pairing task (remote) — drop-in room
- 11:15–12:00: Product & PM conversation (Laura)
- 12:00–12:30: Lunch buffer (candidate rest + scorer sync)
- 13:30–14:15: Deep dive with eng team (Marissa + two ICs)
- 14:30–15:00: Final wrap + recruiter close (Oliver)

Two asks for the panel leads: 1) Are the durations above workable? 2) We’ll use a bundled scorecard and rotate debrief ownership — can Karthik cover the scoring anchor post-design and Laura triage product notes? I attached Alex’s resume and the scorecard template for review.

Alex / Oliver — confirm whether May 27 works, and if candidate prefers UK/US friendly times (Alex flagged PST preference). If we get a yes, I’ll send calendar invites and a short prep note for interviewers.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Recruit Partner — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Alex_Walker_Resume.pdf, FullLoop_Scorecard_Template.xlsx

From: Alex Walker <alex.walker.outlook@gmail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Oliver Reyes <oliver.reyes@recruitco.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview availability / multi-slot orchestration

Thanks Naomi — May 27 works great for me. I’m PST-based (San Diego) and prefer morning blocks, so the schedule you proposed looks fine if the panels start at 09:30 PT.

One small request: can the pairing exercise be ~40 minutes instead of 30? I find the extra 10 helps set up context. Happy to be flexible if that breaks other folks' schedules.

Regards,
Alex

P.S. Oliver — thanks for coordinating on your end.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Reyes <oliver.reyes@recruitco.com>, Alex Walker <alex.walker.outlook@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 16:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Interview availability / multi-slot orchestration

Naomi — thanks for the tidy plan. A couple of operational notes from the system-design side:

1) I can take anchor for the design debrief and consolidate notes into the scorecard right after the panel — I’ll block 11:00–11:15 as the debrief handoff window.
2) I’m fine extending the pairing exercise to 40 minutes, but that would push the product chat later; propose we compress the lunch buffer to 25 minutes (12:00–12:25) and move product to 12:30–13:10. That still leaves a 20-minute cross-check before the afternoon block.
3) For panel swaps: if an interviewer needs to step out, we’ll elevate the onsite backup policy — the backup reviewer will be notified via the shared doc and join the call immediately. Laura / Marissa, can you each confirm a backup person (preferably someone already on the candidate’s day calendar) and add them to the scorecard watchers list?

Also adding a note for interviewer prep: please review the candidate’s last two projects (linked in resume) and flag 2–3 focused prompts so we stay behaviorally consistent across panels.

-Karthik

Alex / Oliver — confirmed for Tuesday, May 27. Per the final micro-adjustments:
- 09:30–10:15 PT: System design (Karthik)
- 10:30–11:10 PT: Pairing exercise (40m) — virtual room link attached
- 11:10–11:25 PT: Design debrief handoff (Karthik)
- 11:30–12:15 PT: Product & PM (Laura)
- 12:15–12:40 PT: Compressed lunch + scorer sync
- 13:30–14:15 PT: Eng deep dive (Marissa + Morgan + Priya)

I’ve sent calendar invites with virtual locations and added Diego Fernandez as Laura’s backup watcher on the scorecard. Attachments: resume + scorecard template.

Prep notes for interviewers (short):
- Keep prompts targeted and timeboxed; we’re aiming for consistent rubrics across panels.
- After your panel, add 2–3 bullet highlights to the scorecard and tag the debrief owner.

Thanks everyone — see you on the 27th.

Naomi
